name: opencode-zenmux-auth
description: OpenCode / magpie provider plugin: ZenMux Builder Plan — sign in with a subscription API key and a Management API key, chat through ZenMux, and show the plan's rolling 5-hour / 7-day Flows

summary.en: ZenMux's Builder Plan (Free / Pro / Max / Ultra) on your subscription API key, with the rolling 5-hour and 7-day Flows and the plan's monthly cap, read with a Management API key.
summary.zh: 用 ZenMux 订阅 API Key 接入 Builder Plan（Free / Pro / Max / Ultra），并通过 Management API Key 读取滚动的 5 小时、7 天 Flows 额度与月度上限。
